text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Oguri
Cap...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's staring at a claw machine full of

Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They just remind me of the plushies
Masa used to
give me.
choice_data_list: ぬいぐるみが欲しいのか？
ぬいぐるみが欲しいの？
choice_data_list_en: Is it the plushie you want?
Is it the plushie you want?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I won a race, Masa would
bring me a
plushie to motivate me to
keep up the good
work.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They were weirdly shaped, homemade
plushies,
but they really made me
happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A-are you sure? I guess I do kinda want
one, but...
why?
choice_data_list: よし、あのぬいぐるみを取ろう！
choice_data_list_en: All right, let's win that plushie!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Thanks. It makes me happy to hear
you say
that. In that case, I'll be
cheering for you.
choice_data_list: これからも頑張ってほしいから！
choice_data_list_en: Because I want you to keep doing your best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail.
